Signed-off-by: xhe <xw897002528@gmail.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #30858 tikv/pd#4467

Problem Summary: `IsolationLevel` takes higher priority than rules of placement rules. So when it is set, placement rules may be violated, which is unwanted. So it is removed.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [x] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
Start tiup with 6 tikv, three of them with `region: r1`, others with `region: r2`.

Create a table with `CONSTRAINTS=[+region=r1] FOLLOWERS=2`, then `show placement`, you should see it is scheduled.

### Release note

<!-- bugfix or new feature needs a release note -->

```release-note
None
```
